Nothing was run or looked up; these are estimates from priors about how these hyperparameters interact. The few claims I put above 40 are interactions I expect from first principles: wider nets learn faster at low learning rates, larger batches take fewer steps and so gain more from a higher learning rate, and narrow nets benefit more from added depth. Most other interactions are likely small or inconsistent across the three datasets, so I kept them low.
